abilities.name: Borrowed Time
abilities.text: Make an Attack as a Free Action against any target in range.

abilities.name: Combat Stimms
abilities.text: Once per round, you can suffer 1 Shock to immediately take a Combat Action. Roll a Opposed Initiative Test if interrupting.

options.name: Chrono Scissor
options.text: Custom Chrono: some Chrono Gladiators are outfitted with different weapons. Uses the same statistics as the normal Chrono Gladiator with the changes listed.

abilities.name: Second Strike
abilities.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by –2DN, as though it had the Dual Wield Talent (p.133).

options.name: Chrono Secutor
options.text: Custom Chrono: some Chrono Gladiators are outfitted with different weapons. Uses the same statistics as the normal Chrono Gladiator with the changes listed: Defence 5, Resilience 8, Speed 5.

abilities.name: Storm Shield
abilities.text: DETERMINATION: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 4d6. This Threat can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds.
